leads.title: Jazz and AbCellera sign deal for T-cell engagers in solid tumours
leads.description: Jazz Pharmaceuticals and AbCellera have signed a preclinical research, option, and licence agreement for the discovery and development of TCE multispecific antibodies for GI cancers and other solid tumours.

leads.title: LG AI Research and D&D Pharmatech sign agreement for oral peptide drugs
leads.description: LG AI Research and D&D Pharmatech have entered into an agreement to collaborate on the development of next-generation oral peptide drugs, the companies announced following a signing ceremony held at the LG Twin Towers in Yeouido, Seoul.
